too_few_examples: too few examples: {real} real, {false_alarms} false alarms (at least {min} of each needed)
not_verifiable_master: learning, but not verifiable yet: needs at least {min} recordings with a master ({n} so far)
not_verifiable_clicks: not verifiable yet (too few real clicks per recording)
usable: estimates the real {kind} per recording to within ±{est}% (raw count ±{raw}%)
too_inaccurate: estimate too inaccurate: ±{est}% per recording (raw count ±{raw}%, at most ±{max}% required)
